# Nexus Clip
> GNOME Shell 45–50 extension: Nexus has its own clipboard (LIFO stack + FIFO of prompts), user-defined shortcuts with per-shortcut prompts, and inference over an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. The system clipboard is touched only by explicit import/export.

## Core files
- extension/extension.js — Extension subclass; dynamic keybinding slots from the `shortcuts` list
- extension/lib/actions.js — orchestration: import/process/export/enqueue/run-next/drain/pop/HUD
- extension/lib/shortcuts.js — PURE: modes, canonical accelerators, defaults, migration, validation
- extension/lib/config.js — GSettings glue: load/save shortcuts, signature, API config
- extension/lib/hud.js — in-shell St/Clutter stack viewer + live streaming panel (no GTK)
- extension/lib/v1client.js — HTTP client: chat() (non-stream) + stream() (SSE), cancellable/timeout
- extension/lib/v1core.js — PURE: buildMessages/buildPayload/parseCompletion
- extension/lib/sse.js — PURE: SSE parser + incremental UTF-8 decoder
- extension/lib/store-core.js — PURE: LIFO/FIFO semantics, node shape, schemaVersion
- extension/lib/store-io.js — shared serialization over an injected file adapter
- extension/lib/store.js — GJS/Gio adapter (shell + prefs)
- tests/helpers/store-node.js — Node fs adapter (tests)
- extension/prefs.js — preferences: API / shortcuts (key capture + prompts) / Nexus / help
- extension/schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.nexus-clip.gschema.xml — GSettings schema
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — architecture, flows, state model, HTTP contract
- docs/USER_GUIDE.md — actions, shortcuts, import/export, queue, and HUD usage
- docs/CONFIGURATION.md — API settings, shortcut schema, GSettings, and local data files
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md — build/install/test/smoke workflow
- docs/CRITICAL_POINTS.md — invariants (freeze, clipboard boundary, state) mapped to tests
- docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md — failure modes (including the old Super+X freeze)
- docs/adr/ — decision log (0001..0010)
- tests/ — node --test (logic + shell/schema contracts) + GJS store/client smoke scripts
- .githooks/ — pre-commit/pre-push run `make check` (enable with `make hooks`)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — `make check` on pull requests and master

## Defaults
- `<Alt><Super>v` — Importar e processar: system clipboard → Nexus stack → prompt → result node.
- `<Alt><Super>c` — Processar pilha: prompt applied to the Nexus top → new result node.
- `copy-top` — export the Nexus top to the system clipboard; unbound by default (capture a key in prefs).
- HUD `Enter` — explicit export of the selected Nexus item.

## Key concepts
- Nexus clipboard = top of `stack.json`. Inference never writes the system clipboard.
- Export is explicit: `copy-top` or HUD Enter. Import is explicit: `push-process`.
- LIFO stack: newest first; results are `kind: "result"` nodes with `parentId` = source.
- FIFO: prompts enqueued as data; `run-next` consumes one per press, `drain` loops; consume only after success.
- Shortcuts: JSON array in GSettings `shortcuts` (`{id,label,accel,mode,prompt}`), mirrored into `hotkey-slot-0..11` for `Main.wm.addKeybinding`.
- Pure/impure split: logic in pure modules (node --test), GJS/UI thin, GJS smoke + manual validation.
- /v1 contract: POST chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible), SSE streaming with `data: [DONE]` terminator.
- GJS/libsoup3: no promisify on send_and_read_async; send_finish() returns Gio.InputStream; TextDecoder has no stream option.
- State: ~/.local/share/nexus-clip-gnome/{stack.json,fifo.json,history.jsonl} (tree-ready via id/parentId).

## Constraints
- GNOME Shell 45–50 (ESM; no imports.gi legacy). Wayland reload (logout/login) needed after install.
- No GTK in the shell process (freeze risk); prefs run in a separate process.
- No credentials in the repo (api-key via dconf). No providers other than OpenAI-compatible /v1.
